programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to a huge number of wild porcupines, living in the city's parks, gardens and streets. Almost twice the average size, Anchorage's porcupines search for food here in the city, and find refuge during the bitter Alaskan winters. But life on the streets also takes its toll.Porcupines are the city's number one roadkill. In the wild, few animals other than wolves attempt to kill porcupines, and in the city, domesticated dogs can be as big a threat to the porcupines as wild wolves.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This unique arctic city is home over 2000 moose! And these notorious animals are running riot... Crossing busy highways, giving birth in backyards, and even doing battle, right here in suburbia! But life on the streets is fraught with danger...and in this expanding city, more highways mean more moose deaths. But the people of Anchorage are on a mission, to protect the most iconic animal in this Wild City.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: There are more Caribou in Alaska than people! Across the Arctic, they're the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline. Out on the tundra, Caribou are the prey of choice for Alaska's carnivores, and at a ranch on the edge of Anchorage, the reindeer are at constant risk from the area's wolves and brown bears. The people of Anchorage have vowed to protect them, but will their help be enough for the Caribou to survive?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: For years, at least four highly elusive wolfpacks have lived and hunted on the edge of the wild city of Anchorage. But as the city spreads further and further into wolf country, the wolves are now getting bolder, and attacks on humans are on the increase. A group was recently targeted whilst jogging with their dog on a trail near one of the city's main roads.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Antarctic
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: One of the most loves animals, famed for its playful nature and incredible underwater agility. Yet most of the life of the otter goes unseen. Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Breeding
programme.desc: Birds do it, bees do it, and so of course do the smallest members of the animal kingdom. Finding a mate is not merely a human pursuit, and few creatures put more vigour, variety and unexpected twists into their love-lives than creepy crawlies! They fill the air with their gentle music and they write their love in the sky. Some battle it out while others just embrace in tender caress. Stand by as they prove that sexual prowess has nothing to do with size - as the creepy crawlies start breeding.

programme.title: Easter The Start of Something Big
programme.desc: Easter, not just a chocolate feast loved by children. One of the biggest events in the religious calendar, celebrated by millions and steeped in customs and traditions. And for all its different meanings there are some key characters we associate with the holiday: chicks, bunnies and lambs have become integral to our celebrations. How have these animals become a part of Easter tradition? There are many twists and turns in the story, but without a doubt this is the start of something big!

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal. 36,000 hectares are home to the rare and plucky Cape Mountain Zebra; the beautiful Bontebok; one of the last remaining breeding colonies of Cape Vultures; the African Black Oystercatcher and the mighty Southern Right Whale.

programme.title: Migrations - Frequent Flyers
programme.desc: Migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena of the natural world, and perhaps the most impressive migrants of all travel on the wing.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Grizzly Bears, Orcas, Elephants, Wolves, Olive Baboons In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders.

programme.title: The Messenger's Box
programme.desc: When high school student Jake Casper finds a small wooden box in the attic of his grandpa's antique store, his life is forever changed, especially when he discovers a secret compartment that appears to contain a nail used during Christ's crucifixion. Now, the more Jake learns of the power within the box and its purpose, the more obstacles he must overcome to get the box to a stranger before it's too late.

programme.title: Lucy Shimmers' Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Second chances start when a hardened criminal crosses paths with a precocious little girl who is helped by an angel to change hearts during the holiday season.

programme.title: Shoelaces for Christmas
programme.desc: Jennifer Miller, a self-centered teenager, learns the importance of giving during the Christmas season when her mother falls ill with cancer. While working at a homeless shelter, she meets unexpected friends who change her perspective.

programme.title: By God's Grace
programme.desc: In the tradition of a classic "A Christmas Carol", this film offers many lessons on the importance of giving and the cause and effect our choices have on others.

programme.title: Christmas on Salvation Street
programme.desc: Noah Davis is a Pastor in an affluent community. Depressed after losing his wife to illness, he is contacted by an old friend who has opened a mission in a rough inner city neighborhood. With Christmas approaching, he packs up and together with his two daughters, moves into Salvation Street Mission. Now the family must struggle with the challenges they face in the crime ridden community.

programme.title: Christmas Grace
programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.title: Homeless For The Holidays
programme.desc: When an uncaring executive falls from the corporate ladder, he learns how difficult it can be to find work and compassion in today's economy. He eventually accepts a humiliating job, but with bills rapidly piling up, and not enough money to go around, he quickly discovers that, unless something changes soon, he'll lose everything by Christmas. Will family and faith be enough to bring joy when you're Homeless for The Holidays?

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.desc: The treacherous story of a man who wore many masks and one that finally earned him the title of one of South Africa's worst serial rapists.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Secret Language of Serial Killers

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Donald Harvey escaped justice for 20 years as he murdered his patients in any way he could. In an exclusive interview, the man who brought him to justice details just how evil Nurse Harvey was. The true extent of his crimes may never be known since so many were undetected for so long.He claims to have killed 87 patients, but official estimates suggest the figure us nearer 60.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Nurse Malcolm Webster knew how to sedate someone so deeply that they simply would not wake - no matter what was going on around them. He could - and did - drive cars off the road deliberately with the intention of setting them on fire and killing his passenger. He was on the way to using his Nursing skills to kill a third woman when he was finally captured.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: Police attend a bloody machete attack, a citizen threatens officer with a golf club and shots are fired in a residential neighborhood.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: A suspect attacks clerks in a supermarket, officers locate a hand grenade and a jilted lover tries to break into a residence.

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: In 1888, a series of gruesome murders shocked London: The perpetrator was dubbed "Jack the Ripper". This was the Victorian era, when puritanism reigned and forensic science was in its infancy. How did these factors combine to create one of the most renowned crime stories in history, resulting in the construction of the serial killer?

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: Paris, January 1907. Albert Soleilland is accused of the rape and murder of a little girl - Marthe. The press details every step of the case as if it was a show. As early century France was on the verge of abolishing the death sentence, that infamous crime set the abolitionist cause back decades - the media massively and eagerly asked for his execution.
programme.sub-title: Albert Soleilland: A Case for the Death Penalty (1907)

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When a law school student is strangled to death, detectives find that someone had been secretly watching her.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud get to the "root" of spicing up your food as they cook dishes using spice roots! Next up, a frosty, golden Turmeric Semifreddo, studded with jewel-like apricots and pistachios! Last but not least is a steaming bowl of mussels, spiced with not one, not two, but three kinds of ginger! How can you not 'root' for these dishes?

programme.title: Spice Secrets

Finally, a pork tenderloin with a simple mixed berry sauce. Where's the fennel you ask? They rub the pork with fennel-cousin cumin for some smoky aroma and flavour! Remember... a pinch of spice makes a world of difference!

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Minneapolis, Minnesota: Tony travels to the grain belt capitol, Minneapolis, to inspect the conflict between creative independent operators and generic franchises. Beginning in the food nightmare within the Mall of America, Anthony vows to find good cuisine within the city.
programme.sub-title: The Struggle for the Soul of America

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Sydney, Australia: Bourdain embarks on a pilgrimage through Australia to indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs, Tetsuya Wakuda. Days, miles and many Australian meals later, Anthony finds himself unable to describe Tetsuya's delicious and well-earned meal.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Melbourne, Australia: Melbourne boasts a bunch of hard-living, good-natured, and eccentric food-lovers. In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop. Alas, no trip to Australia is complete without an authentic "barbie", so Bourdain settles down with new found friends for an afternoon meal of surf n' turf.
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking

programme.title: Secrets of the Caribbean
programme.desc: From Puerto Rico to Anguilla to Tobago Cays and beyond, we have delicious meals and very special stories to share with you from the S.O.C. team's most memorable Caribbean visits.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella Ri'chard: Seattle
programme.desc: Join Denella in this one-hour special to one of America's most interesting cities. Seattle is among the country's fastest growing cities, and Denella will show you why people gravitate to this enchanting place. Get ready for an adventure.

programme.title: Porthole Cruise and Travel Show
programme.desc: Bill Panoff recommends Atlas Ocean Voyage's World Navigator for one such journey, an adventure that will enliven the human spirit within you.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Donna reveals the luxurious and family-friendly environment of Disney Cruise Line's, Disney Wonder. First-class spa treatment and a cooking demonstration by the Wonder's Executive Chef are featured, as is a firework show, Disney style.

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: John Wright explores methods of smoking the three pillars of the alcohol world in Booze Bites, Pam Corbin savors the fall harvest with a farmhouse fruitcake in Cake Bites, and Mark Diacono shares his garden favorites in Veg Bites.

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: From the field to the bottle, John Wright reveals how to make homemade and delicious Blackberry Wine you would be proud to share with family and friends. He will also show you how to make a batch of orange beer using two blends of hops.
programme.sub-title: Booze Bites: Blackberry Wine and Orange Beer

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: Steve Lamb reveals tried and true methods for both dry and wet curing using bacon and pancetta. Then, using ham hock and duck, Steve and Tim Maddams show you how brining can lead to wonderful results.
programme.sub-title: Smoking and Curing: Dry Curing and Brining

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: On the streets of Morelia, you will find Enchiladas a la Plaza, a wondrous style of enchilada in which a spoonful of richly flavored vegetables is piled atop (not inside) seared, red chili-flavored tortillas. Here is Rick's delish recipe.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Though these are more traditionally made with chicken, Rick's favorite version is made with a mixture of roasted vegetables. For this recipe, he calls for a modest amount of cheese melted on top, but you can always add more.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Warm and fruit-filled, ponche is the traditional punch served at Christmastime posadas in Mexico. Serve it without alcohol or spike it con piquete ("with a little bite") by adding white rum.

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: The very best tamales are made from fresh-ground corn masa, and fresh-rendered pork lard. You can make delicious tamales with alternative ingredients, as well. First, Rick outlines the equipment and basic ingredients you will need.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Shipwreck Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: A story about his great grandfather inspires Ross to dive the James Eagan Layne with the goal of recovering its military supplies. Ross then explores the legendary HMS Amethyst where he and his team discover a remarkable artifact.

programme.title: The World's Most Expensive Cruise Ship
programme.desc: The Seven Seas Splendor is in Iceland for the first time in its history, embarking on a cruise to absorb Scandinavia's stunning scenery. Lizzie is the new social hostess, or as she is affectionately dubbed, 'The First Lady of the Ship.'

programme.title: Inside America's National Parks
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a geological wonder, a hiker's paradise, one of the best parks to see wildlife, and an irresistible lure for thrill seekers. In this exhilarating program, climb a sheer cliff wall, raft a raging river, visit an avalanche lab, spend a day with a fearless search and rescue team, hang your Stetson at a working dude ranch, and rough it in style at posh retreats.

programme.title: Yosemite: America's Treasure
programme.desc: Experience Yosemite's incredible wonders with breathtaking cinematography, including such icons as the granite monoliths El Capitan and Half Dome, and the spectacular Bridal Veil and Yosemite Falls. Learn about Yosemite's fascinating history as the first land set aside for preservation that inspired John Muir and photographer Ansel Adams and discover why Yosemite is one of America's Crown Jewels.

programme.title: National Parks Revealed
programme.desc: Meet the dedicated people of America's national parks who help preserve national monuments and conserve each park's unspoiled beauty. From rappelling down the towering granite faces of Mount Rushmore to executing a prescribed burn in the Grand Canyon and plowing the treacherous Going-to-the-Sun Road in Glacier National Park, their job is riddled with challenges and rewards.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why did the architect Viollet-le-Duc only work on Roquetaillade Castle? Why is there a monolithic church in St. Emilion? Why is there a wall around the village of Blaye? Why was the Bourg-en-Gironde built into a cliff? What is the King's Fig? And how do Cadillac and Pauillac make time stand still?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: How did Dublin get its name? Who was Maewyn Succat? How did the harp become a symbol of Ireland, and why do the harps on Irish coins and Guinness beer look different? What is the curious history of the Book of Kells, and how did it make its way into Trinity College's Longroom Library?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Who were the Habsburgs, Maria Theresa, Franz Joseph and Sisi? What is the Ringstrasse? Where did Mozart perform as a 6-year-old prodigy? When and why did Austria shrink to a tenth of its size? What do the eagles on the rooftop of St. Stephen's Cathedral symbolize?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Yorkshire is replete with rolling hills, quaint stone cottages, and sprawling country estates. Why are country estates named Castles and Abbeys? What is The Shambles, and how did it get its name? Why is one of the largest medieval Gothic cathedrals in Europe in the small town of York?

programme.sub-title: Best Parks to Star in Your Own Western

Climb the face of a monolith millions of years in the making, seek out a sunrise horseback ride through cactus country, uncover the mysteries of the scorching desert, and meet some of the Southwest's hardiest inhabitants, from geckos to Gila Monsters.
programme.sub-title: National Parks of the Great Southwest

programme.title: Disney Parks
programme.desc: It was Walt Disney's original vision that Disneyland would "never be completed" - always growing and changing. Now, decades later it remains one of the most visited vacation destinations in the world. Disney Parks has proven its ability to not only remain relevant but continues to be at the very top of the theme park game.

Let's explore the curious world of Royal Warrants, a special designation given to only the best shops and services, literally fit for a king (or queen, or prince, or princess). Kind of like knighthood for a shop.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Who is buried under Glasgow Cathedral, and why? Who is Saint Mungo, and why is he so big? Why does Glasgow City Chambers look like a palace? How did this seaport town become a center for Scottish Enlightenment? And how did Charles Rennie Macintosh's creativity leave a permanent mark on this city?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: After nearly 500 years, French is still the official language of Quebec City. How has this UNESCO World Heritage Site retained its 'Frenchness' over time? programme.desc: Pamela's tour of Hanoi continues with her new friends from OneTrip Adventures and Vietnam Backstreet Tours who introduce Pamela to the local cuisine, as well as the Hoa Binh Market. Pamela also shares an important monetary travel tip.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.desc: Pamela and friends soak in a bit more of Hanoi prior to Pamela embarking to Bangkok, Thailand where an exquisite suite at the Avani+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel awaits her. What is there to experience in Bangkok? Pamela will show you the way.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.desc: Pamela finishes her stay in Bangkok by experiencing Chinese New Year. She then reflects on her travels overall, believing that the art of solo travel is about the relationships she builds with the people she meets along her journeys.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela returns to where it all began, the Southern Italian beach town of Minturno, where her parents immigrated from over 40 years ago. She reconnects with her roots during the town's biggest celebration, the annual La Sagra delle Regne.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela gets up close and personal with the locals as she heads to Buenos Aires, Argentina to learn the seductive dance of tango. From attending the world's largest tango festival to dancing on the city's main stage, Mickela sees it all.

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: Pam Corbin's love for baking shines through as she reveals how to bake two cake classics: a Victoria sandwich cake and a chocolate cake. She also bakes a savory potato and apple cake, and a delightful banana bread.
programme.sub-title: Cake Bites: Classics, Fruity and Frugal

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version

programme.sub-title: Booze Bites: Gin Alexanders and Summer Flower Beers

programme.title: Exploring Mexico's Kitchen with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Bunuelos are remarkably thin, golden, crispy pastry disks that are popular throughout much of Mexico, especially around Christmastime, and are an obsession of Rick Baylesses.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: While there, she discovers Emirati culture and cuisine, experiences an upscale desert safari, goes scuba diving, and more. Donna explores Dubai, one of the gems of the Middle East.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: After being inspired by Drunken Prawns in a home dedicated to whisky, Jeremy makes Cinnamon Bao Doughnuts and Chocolate Sauce. Jeremy's BBQ Chicken Wings with Spicy Slaw is sure to impress.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In Diane's adopted city of Athens, the food scene is timeless, groundbreaking, and sensational. From mouthwatering Souvlaki to Michelin-starred haute Greek cuisine, the amazing flavors of Athens bubble over in every pot.

programme.title: Primal Grill with Steven Raichlen
programme.desc: Early grills had no grates-just embers. Experience cooking like a caveman with roasted eggplants for baba ghanouj, sweet potatoes, and beef tenderloin in salt-wrapped cloth. For dessert, a twist on s'mores.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: Kathy McCabe invites you to experience the essence of Rome. Discover the Testaccio Market's incredible food, taste true Roman Cacio e Pepe and gelato, learn the beautiful craft of mosaics, and attend a grand ball at Palazzo Brancaccio.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Proper Pub Food
programme.desc: Tom reveals how to prepare classic, crowd-pleasing pub meals, such as a classic Caesar salad, quirky beer snacks, pork belly with lentils and cabbage salsa, fish and chips, and date and toffee pudding with toffee sauce. Hungry?

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: Betty and Lorcan's daughter Colleen moved to Cyprus but some of her taste buds stayed behind in Castlebar. After becoming acquainted with Lorcan's recipe for honey-glazed ham, Catherine prepares the special dish for Colleen and her family.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: The Dodecanese islands represent a fascinating tapestry of customs, foods, landscapes, and history. Diane delves into the common threads and ingredients that characterize the cuisine of this unique island group in three memorable recipes.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip Davenport accompanies us to Waku Ghin at Marina Bay Sands in Singapore run by one of Australia's finest chefs, Tetsuya Wakuda. Chef Wakuda imparts his culinary wisdom in the kitchen and takes us down into his superb wine cellar.

programme.title: Takeaway Titans
programme.desc: Ireland's top Indian takeaways spice and sizzle it up in the kitchen hoping to please the palates of Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Hugh Wallace, for a chance at competing in the final cook off.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella Ri'chard
programme.desc: A warm welcome awaits you in Bermuda, a captivating island set upon the edge of a dormant underwater volcano. Famous for its pink sand beaches, Bermuda is also steeped in history, rich in cultural influences, and full of communal spirit.

programme.title: Mexico: One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: In the land of the tortilla, bread is often overlooked. If Chef Elena Reygadas has anything to say about it, however, bread will soon rise as an important player in Mexican cuisine, and she certainly has the right tools to effect change.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella Ri'chard
programme.desc: Denella visits the historic Boston, Massachusetts. She experiences the energy of Fenway Park, explores Boston's outdoor art scene, and discovers history of the United States' founding around every corner.

programme.title: The Toque 12 - Master Chefs
programme.desc: Chefs Tetsuya Wakuda, Justin Quek, and David Myers wine and dine us at their upper echelon restaurants, share their love of food, introduce us to a few special dishes, and even let us eves drop on one of their master class sessions.

programme.title: River Cottage Bites Extended Version
programme.desc: After foraging for the main ingredient, the sweet Alexander Plant, John Wright heads to the shore to create a smooth Gin Alexander. Also, summer flowers can be used in the creation of some inspiring infused liquor concoctions.
programme.sub-title: Booze Bites: Gin Alexanders and Summer Flower Beers

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: This show focuses on foods you never dreamed you could smoke: Camembert cheese on a cedar plank with pepper jelly and jalapeños, hay-smoked reverse-seared steaks with chipotle salsa, and a smoky Mary cocktail.
programme.sub-title: You Can Smoke What? Extreme Smoking

programme.title: Primal Grill with Steven Raichlen
programme.desc: Spit-roasting is one of the oldest grilling methods, perfect for juicy meat with a crispy crust. Here's the lowdown on spit-roasting duck, prime rib, and baby back ribs.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane reveals the ancient grains that Greek cooks love to use. Learn how to make the classic Cretan Barley Rusk (twice baked bread) called Paximadi, as well as a savory pasta dish. Also, observe how trahana can transform a dish.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: In this episode, learn to make barbecued Berkshire pork belly, house-cured pastrami, and Kentucky-style lamb shoulder with unique black barbecue sauce, "dip." Plus, discover a new twist on a classic cocktail-a smoked Manhattan!

programme.title: Travels with Darley
programme.desc: Darley finds culinary delights inspired by Mobile's architecture and history before traveling to Montgomery in search of a truly famous hot dog. She completes her tour at Auburn University where local collaboration thrives.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Emerald green Greek extra virgin olive oil is the star of this show as we watch it flow from tree to kitchen in the stunningly preserved town of Monemvasia. Explore the diversity and beauty of one of Greece's most delectable exports.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: We begin with a hike to find white truffles before attending the World Truffle Auction. We will also visit Cascina Bruciata vineyard, Lago delle Sorgenti for some deep relaxation, as well as Lake Iseo to witness fine Italian boat making.

programme.title: Bigger Bolder Baking with Gemma Stafford
programme.desc: Elevate your desserts with chef Gemma Stafford's no-bake summer treats! Make chocolate delights, frozen treats, and more without turning on the oven. Enjoy easy recipes & expert tips from the renowned chef, author, & creator of Bigger Bolder Baking.

programme.title: Mexico: One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: In Mexico, hot chocolate and coffee are equally enjoyed. The Seasons of My Heart Cooking School explains the roasting process from two perspectives, while the Finca Las Nieves Coffee Plantation offers a look into organic coffee production.
programme.sub-title: Chocolate & Coffee from Bean to Cup

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Join Diane and explore the origins of the phyllo pie from New York City to the Greek countryside. We will also learn how to create Spanakopita, Messy Orange Pie, and how to use phyllo as a base for an array of savory and sweet dishes.

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: We join Catherine in New Zealand where we discover the country's finest wine and cheesemakers and dine with Michelin Star Chef Adam Newell. We will also explore Maori culture and cuisine, visit Wildlife Sanctuary Zealandia, and much more.

programme.title: Travels with Darley
programme.desc: Saratoga, New York was the location of a major turning point in the American Revolution. Sumptuous food and beer prepare us for visits to Schuyler House, Saratoga Monument, and Saratoga National Historical Park to feel history's energy.

programme.title: The Toque 12

programme.title: Culinary Travels With Dave Eckert

programme.sub-title: Vegas - On and Off the Strip

programme.title: Primal Grill with Steven Raichlen

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Good things may come in small packages, but when it comes to barbecue, bigger is better. Learn to think (and smoke) big with oversized cuts of meat, a whole suckling pig, and an epic dessert.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella Ri'chard
programme.desc: Denella visits Little Rock, Arkansas, the state's capital city. She experiences world-class attractions, outdoor activities, and unique neighborhoods that make Little Rock an outstanding weekend destination.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.

programme.title: The Golden Girls: Ageless
programme.desc: During seven years of cheesecake and massive laughs, "The Golden Girls" was TV's unlikeliest hit; pairing three seasoned TV pros and one small-screen newbie with impeccable writing resulted in a sitcom that was as progressive as it was hilarious.

programme.title: Autopsy: The Last Hours Of ...
programme.desc: Actress Rue McClanahan ("The Golden Girls") dies of a stroke, which is most commonly caused by a blood clot to the brain; however, McClanahan was reportedly taking a powerful anticoagulant medication at the time of her death.

programme.title: On Patrol: Live
programme.desc: St. Lucie County, Fla. officers apprehend suspects after an undercover drug deal while officers in Humboldt, Calif. find large amounts of marijuana during a traffic stop; Daytona Beach, Fla. officers search for a man accused of indecent exposure.

programme.title: On Patrol: Live
programme.desc: Monroe County, La. officers investigate shots fired while officers in Arkansas County, Ark. use a drone to find a suspect; officers in Daytona Beach, Fla. stop a fleeing vehicle.

programme.title: Elizabeth Montgomery: A Bewitched Life
programme.desc: Among the most enduring TV sitcoms of all time, Bewitched remains beloved nearly sixty years after its debut. Bewitched became one of television's biggest hits during the turbulent 1960s, a time that was symbolic of the series' behind-the-scenes turmoil.

programme.desc: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera.

programme.title: Basic Instinct 2
programme.desc: After a crash that kills her boyfriend, Catherine Tramell (Sharon Stone) has her car searched by the police, who find illegal drugs. Prosecutors handling her case send Tramell to see psychiatrist Michael Glass (David Morrissey). Glass determines that Tramell, a novelist whose books deal with sensational murders, might just be a dangerous person herself. But his findings don't prevent him from embarking on a sexually charged relationship with the cunning cougar.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: Wisegirls
programme.desc: Low on money and fresh out of hope, aspiring doctor Meg Kennedy (Mira Sorvino) is forced to return home to Staten Island, N.Y., where she finds work as a waitress at Santalino's, a boisterous Italian restaurant. Soon, Meg befriends coworkers Raychel (Mariah Carey) and Kate (Melora Walters) and begins to start a new life. But, after Meg discovers that Santalino's is a mob front, she finds herself deep in danger, and is recruited by the police to spy on her criminally connected boss.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Tired of the crime overrunning the streets of Boston, Irish Catholic twin brothers Conner (Sean Patrick Flanery) and Murphy (Norman Reedus) are inspired by their faith to cleanse their hometown of evil with their own brand of zealous vigilante justice. As they hunt down and kill one notorious gangster after another, they become controversial folk heroes in the community. But Paul Smecker (Willem Dafoe), an eccentric FBI agent, is fast closing in on their blood-soaked trail.

programme.title: Out of the Furnace
programme.desc: Steelworker Russell Baze (Christian Bale) works a dead-end job and holds tight to his sense of family, duty and loyalty. Rodney Baze (Casey Affleck), Russell's brother, returns home after serving in Iraq and, with his debts piling up, becomes entangled with a vicious crime lord (Woody Harrelson). Soon afterward, Rodney disappears mysteriously. The police fail to solve the case, so Russell -- feeling he has little left to lose -- puts his life on the line to bring his brother home.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: Fame Kills: Whitney Houston
programme.desc: Revisiting the tragic death of Whitney Houston at the Beverly Hilton Hotel.

programme.title: How The Beatles Changed the World
programme.desc: The fascinating story of the cultural, social, spiritual and musical revolution ignited by the Beatles.

programme.title: Bowie: The Man Who Changed the World
programme.desc: A look at David Bowie's influence on music, art and culture; featuring interviews with some of the people who knew him best.

programme.title: F/X
programme.desc: Rollie Tyler (Bryan Brown) is a special-effects expert for low-budget Hollywood movies. As gangster Nicholas DeFranco (Jerry Orbach) prepares to testify in court against his former bosses, FBI agents, fearing Nicholas will be killed by the mob before he can take the stand, decide to fake his assassination. The agents hire Rollie to use his special-effects skills to make the murder look believable. Leo McCarthy (Brian Dennehy), a detective, steps in to investigate the murder.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.desc: When Nazi forces invaded Holland in 1940 and began rounding up Jews, Corrie ten Boom, her sister Betsie, and their elderly father risked their lives to save as many as possible. A hidden room was secretly built in their home where the oppressed Jews took refuge until a Gestapo raid put an end to their operation. Corrie ten Boom.

programme.title: We are Stronger
programme.desc: We Are Stronger is a faith-based film exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD. While Vic struggles to recover from his physical injuries, reclaim his marriage, and adjust to life after combat, he discovers he can't do it alone. Made in cooperation with the Stronger Alliance, Mighty Oaks, CRU Military, Amos House of Faith, Armed Forces Mission, and more who are dedicated to trauma recovery.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy 2
programme.desc: Author Betsy Simon (Karen Lesiewicz) finally finds career success when her new novel, Heavens to Betsy, is published. Following advice from her agent (Ruth Kaufman), she tells the public that the book is a work of fiction. After talking with Pastor John (Jim O'Heir from TV's 'Parks and Recreation') she claims that the events portrayed in the book actually happened to her!

programme.title: Wesley: A Heart Transformed Can Change the World

programme.title: Hudson Taylor: Into the Heart of the Dragon

programme.title: We Were There

programme.title: Betrayal of Trust
